entries.en: to finish perfectly; to complete entirely

entries.zh: 完；做完、完毕（m.te 为 ment(e) 缩写，同页第 1 条全拼可证）
entries.en: to finish completely, perfectly
finished, concluded; complete and full
finished, concluded; accomplished
to finish or settle one's affairs; complete

entries.zh: 已果；事已成就、已成定局（果取成就、成实义）
